diet.note: Martinez et al. (2011) read its tooth crowns as evidence of an omnivorous, if not wholly herbivorous, diet. Older accounts that treated it as a theropod describe it as a meat eater (NHM Dino Directory).

timeRange.note: All Ischigualasto dinosaurs, Eoraptor included, come from the Scaphonyx-Exaeretodon-Herrerasaurus biozone, dated by Martinez et al. (2011) to 231.5-229 Ma (late Carnian). Only one PBDB occurrence (Ischigualasto, Carnian).

lengthM.note: Sereno's lab page gives 3 feet (about 0.9 m); the NHM Dino Directory gives 1.7 m.

massKg.note: Single published estimate (NHM Dino Directory); method not stated.

text.en: Eoraptor was a small dinosaur from the Ischigualasto rocks of Argentina. It lived about 231 to 229 million years ago and was roughly 1 to 1.7 metres long. It was first described as an early meat eater, but a 2011 study placed it among the early relatives of the giant long-necked sauropods, with teeth suggesting it ate plants and perhaps small animals.
Eoraptor and its neighbour Eodromaeus are the only dinosaurs known to keep tiny teeth on the roof of the mouth.

uncertain.note: Originally described as a theropod (Sereno et al. 1993; still shown as a theropod on the NHM Dino Directory and Sereno lab page). Martinez et al. (2011) reinterpreted it as a basal sauropodomorph, which PBDB follows.
